docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The life of the Chinese pilgrim Xuanzang in India, by his disciple Hwui-li, translated by Samuel Beal, with Beal’s introduction on Indian Buddhism (London, 1914). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised for the Digital Library of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Life Of Hiuen Tsiang · Beal,samuel. · 1914, 278 scanned pages. Published 1914; Samuel Beal died 1889; Hwui-li lived in the seventh century; public domain in India.

The scans of this book are not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page was read from the scan by machine (OCR) for this library, and lightly cleaned; it may contain errors, and the scan of every page is one button away.
